question: Does any declared cpu_timeout sit at or below the real CPU-seconds a healthy run of that node consumes (i.e. is any node at risk of a false kill)?
verdict: No. 42/42 portable passing nodes with a declared budget, and 7/7 privileged, ran strictly below budget. Zero false-kills.

measurement.cpu_s_definition: runner cgroup cpu.stat user_s + sys_s (additive work, sibling-independent, contamination-proof under co-tenant load)
measurement.boxing: default (no --allow-cgroup-failure); systemd --user CPUQuota per-step, cgroup cpu.stat populated

join.false_kill_risk_criterion: cpu_s >= cpu_timeout for a passing node

results.one_non_pass_node: test.detcore_misc (livelock 599.99 cpu_s, wall-caught at 600s; cpu_timeout=810 never fires by design)
